evidence: For the deposition of the iridium catalyst we developed a novel ALD reaction based on the commercially available precursor ethylcyclopentadienyl-1,3-cyclohexadiene iridium (I), (EtCp)Ir(CHD). When (EtCp)Ir(CHD) and ozone (O3) are pulsed in alternating fashion on planar substrates (Si wafers coated with alumina or indium tin oxide (ITO)), a film growth is observed by spectroscopic ellipsometry
